title: Chapter 151
text:
Before Han Xiao's arrival, Balsas had used a few meager resources to drive the players to hunt down the beasts. However, Balsas had discovered something strange. Every time the refugees went out to hunt, they would always come back unscathed. There was not a single casualty. Later on, he noticed something shocking. These refugees seemed to have the ability to resurrect themselves, so they would not truly die.

This discovery shocked Balsas. If it was just one person with the ability to revive, he would not be surprised. However, it was unbelievable that a group of people had the ability to revive. Could it be that the ability was contagious? Just like the Bear Tribe in the myths, their saliva would contaminate the genes. How could they turn normal people into their own kind when they bit them?

After some observation, Balsas realized that even a small profit could satisfy them. His mind suddenly became active.

If I can get these weird refugees to become my subordinates, with their ability to revive, no enemy will be able to defeat me. I won't have to be afraid of Black Pine's people anymore.

Although the refugees all had the ability to resurrect, their individual combat strength was very weak. Balsas had once asked the refugees about their origins, but the answers he received were all meaningless nonsense. No one could tell him anything. Balsas was a little conflicted about this, but it was not a big deal. He only wanted to use the refugees as cannon fodder. Their origins were not important, so he decided not to look into it for the time being. Instead, he was prepared to buy as much as he could.

However, before he could do anything, Black Phantom arrived and was being chased by the refugees. Balsas immediately became alert.

Black Phantom came specifically for this group of refugees? He also knew about the uniqueness of this group of refugees?

Black Phantom was not to be trifled with, so Balsas decided to wait and see. However, an accident happened. The beasts living nearby attacked the town.

Hordes of beasts that covered the mountains and plains attacked from the forest, causing the ground to rumble and shake.

The majority of the beasts were Gray Devil Wolves. Their fur was gray and black, and they were the size of wild cows. There were also thick purple pythons that were more than ten meters long swimming among the wolves.

Beast hordes were very common in the wild. It was a disaster that every settlement had to face. Balsas did not hesitate to order the town to be sealed off. He had the soldiers control the machine guns on top of the walls and defend against the hordes from above. The players who were left outside the town became a buffer zone. Balsas was glad that he had this group of refugees as cannon fodder.

You have triggered an emergency mission [Protect Green Valley Town]!

It wasn't just the players. Even the Han Technician had received an Emergency Quest. The reward was only a few thousand EXP. Han Xiao watched the players fight the monsters with great interest.

Balsas realized that Han Xiao had somehow climbed up the wall and was calmly looking at the battlefield below. Balsas's heart skipped a beat. Black Phantom was able to climb up the wall under the watchful eyes of so many people, which meant that he could easily approach him. He was indeed a meritorious assassin of the Dark Net. His movements were silent and unpredictable.

The players defended Green Valley Town and fought back with all their might. The scene was bloody. Fortunately, they had the support of the town's machine guns. The flames and gunshots never stopped. Otherwise, the players of this level would have been defeated. Han Xiao paid attention to the performance of the players. At this time, Green Valley Town only had two main classes of players, Espers and Mechanics.

He saw many Esper abilities that strengthened the body, such as super strength, endurance, or speed, rapid self-healing, and elemental manipulation, such as gathering rocks to form armor. There were all kinds of strange Esper abilities. Although they were all low-level abilities and did not last long, they still managed to injure some Gray Devil Wolves. Only the Esper players' performance was slightly better.

The battle between the monsters and the players was chaotic. Some players recorded the battle and posted it on the forum.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes, got up and jumped down the wall. He decided to end the battle quickly.

Activating the Electromagnetic Hover-boots, Han Xiao jumped into the battlefield as if he was stepping on a piece of slippery ice. Like a flash of black lightning, he went straight for a smaller Gray Devil Wolf. This wolf was very old and had sparse fur. It was the leader of the pack, and Han Xiao had noticed it when he was observing the battlefield.

Han Xiao did not plan to use sniping to deal with the monsters. He lacked AOE damage, and he had limited ammo. It was a good opportunity to test his LV 50 skills. Even if he was a Mechanic, he could still crush these LV 20 monsters with his physical fitness.

The Beast Tide was a common disaster in Blue Star. If it was a large Beast Tide that stretched as far as the eye could see, he would not be careless. It was very dangerous to be alone in a Beast Tide, and he would be attacked at all times.

The Beast Tide in Green Valley Town was very small, only about a thousand wolves and snakes. Han Xiao had something to rely on, so he dared to show off.

A few stronger Gray Devil Wolves surrounded the Wolf King like guards. The old Gray Devil Wolf King roared at Han Xiao, and the guards immediately pounced.

Huge claws slapped toward him. Han Xiao was covered in Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor. He raised his arm to block the attack, creating a loud bang. A circle of dust rose under his feet as he blocked the attack of the Gray Devil Wolf that was four to five times larger.

His Strength was 69, much higher than the LV 20 Gray Devil Wolf. His five fingers grabbed the Gray Devil Wolf's claws, and his fingers dug into the flesh. He threw the Gray Devil Wolf behind him, and a small hole was smashed in the ground by the huge body of the wolf. The wolf immediately let out a painful cry.

Seeing this scene, the players' hearts skipped a beat. It was like a dwarf throwing a normal person over his shoulder. The scene was very shocking.

Han Xiao felt the strength of his body, and he was overjoyed. His fists were like a pile driver, landing on the bodies of the Gray Devil Wolves one after another. Bang! Bang! Bang! The force went deep into the organs of the Gray Devil Wolves. Every punch was a crushing force. The Gray Devil Wolves that were close to him were sent flying. They stood up shakily and pounced again, but they were sent flying again. The places where they were hit were left with purple bruises.

The surrounding wolves rushed to protect the Wolf King. Han Xiao's vision was completely blocked by the Gray Devil Wolves. Their sharp claws and teeth attacked him from all directions. The scale-like Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor created sparks, but it was impossible to break through. Han Xiao had to bear the force from all directions, and it was difficult for him to move.

It is indeed not easy to carve a bloody path out of the Beast Tide. Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he activated the Repulsive Field Actuator. A powerful force erupted with him as the center, and the surrounding wolves were all sent flying. The Gray Devil Wolves that were further away were knocked over, and they rolled on the ground together.

The path ahead was smooth. Han Xiao buckled his toes and charged toward the Wolf King at full power. The wind blew past his ears, and the distance between them was closed in the blink of an eye. He casually blocked the Wolf King's desperate bite, twisted the Wolf King's head with both hands, and flipped the Wolf King to the ground. He pressed his knee on the Wolf King's abdomen and pinned it to the ground. His left hand pressed on the Wolf King's head, and his right hand clenched into a fist and punched the Wolf King repeatedly. The Wolf King's head was quickly deformed under the powerful punches, and blood splattered everywhere.

He could feel the power generated by the stretching of his muscles, tendons, and bones every time he punched. It was like a drawn bowstring, accumulating a tremendous amount of power. He felt a sense of fullness in his control.

The Wolf King's weak point was the abdomen, but Han Xiao liked to hit the head.

After a few punches, the Wolf King was on the verge of death. The wolves howled and abandoned their original enemies, pouncing on Han Xiao and drowning him. The large pack of wolves pressed him down like a small mountain. Han Xiao was pinned to the ground, and there were many wolves on top of him.

The stench of the Gray Devil Wolves entered his nose clearly. Han Xiao frowned, and he almost choked on the smell. His sensitive senses faithfully analyzed the components of the smell.
